items.source: One is to assemble a processing chain that consists of a target WebHandler, then decorated with a set of WebFilters, then further decorated with a set of WebExceptionHandlers.
items.translation: 一种方法是组装一个处理链，该链由目标WebHandler组成，然后装饰有一组WebFilters，再进一步装饰有一组WebExceptionHandlers。

items.source: The second purpose is to adapt the resulting processing chain to an HttpHandler: the lowest-level reactive HTTP handling abstraction which can then be used with any of the supported runtimes. The adaptation is done with the help of HttpWebHandlerAdapter.
items.translation: 第二个目的是将生成的处理链适配为 `HttpHandler`：这是最低级别的反应式 HTTP 处理抽象，可随后与任何支持的运行时一起使用。该适配借助于 `HttpWebHandlerAdapter` 完成。

items.source: The processing chain can be assembled manually via builder methods, or detected from a Spring ApplicationContext via applicationContext, or a mix of both.
items.translation: 处理链可以通过构建器方法手动组装，也可以通过 `applicationContext` 从 Spring ApplicationContext 检测，或者两者混合使用。

items.source: By default DefaultWebSessionManager is used.
items.translation: 默认情况下，使用DefaultWebSessionManager。

items.source:
Static factory method to create a new builder instance by detecting beans in an ApplicationContext. The following are detected:
  • WebHandler [1] -- looked up by the name WEB_HANDLER_BEAN_NAME.
  • WebFilter [0..N] -- detected by type and ordered, see AnnotationAwareOrderComparator.
  • WebExceptionHandler [0..N] -- detected by type and ordered.
  • HttpHandlerDecoratorFactory [0..N] -- detected by type and ordered.
  • ObservationRegistry -- detected by type and configured if unique.
  • ServerRequestObservationConvention -- detected by type and configured if unique.
  • WebSessionManager [0..1] -- looked up by the name WEB_SESSION_MANAGER_BEAN_NAME.
  • ServerCodecConfigurer [0..1] -- looked up by the name SERVER_CODEC_CONFIGURER_BEAN_NAME.
  • LocaleContextResolver [0..1] -- looked up by the name LOCALE_CONTEXT_RESOLVER_BEAN_NAME.
items.translation:
用于通过检测 ApplicationContext 中的 Bean 来创建新构建器实例的静态工厂方法。检测到以下内容：
  • WebHandler [1] -- 通过名称 WEB_HANDLER_BEAN_NAME 查找。
  • WebFilter [0..N] -- 通过类型检测并排序，参见 AnnotationAwareOrderComparator。
  • WebExceptionHandler [0..N] -- 通过类型检测并排序。
  • HttpHandlerDecoratorFactory [0..N] -- 通过类型检测并排序。
  • ObservationRegistry -- 通过类型检测，如果唯一则进行配置。
  • ServerRequestObservationConvention -- 通过类型检测，如果唯一则进行配置。
  • WebSessionManager [0..1] -- 通过名称 WEB_SESSION_MANAGER_BEAN_NAME 查找。
  • ServerCodecConfigurer [0..1] -- 通过名称 SERVER_CODEC_CONFIGURER_BEAN_NAME 查找。
  • LocaleContextResolver [0..1] -- 通过名称 LOCALE_CONTEXT_RESOLVER_BEAN_NAME 查找。

items.source: Configure a Function to decorate the HttpHandler returned by this builder which effectively wraps the entire WebExceptionHandler - WebFilter - WebHandler processing chain.
items.translation: 配置一个 `Function` 来装饰此构建器返回的 `HttpHandler`，从而有效地包装整个 `WebExceptionHandler` - `WebFilter` - `WebHandler` 处理链。

items.source: Configure a Function to decorate the HttpHandler returned by this builder which effectively wraps the entire WebExceptionHandler - WebFilter - WebHandler processing chain. This provides access to the request and response before the entire chain and likewise the ability to observe the result of the entire chain.
items.translation: 配置一个 Function 来装饰此构建器返回的 HttpHandler，从而有效地包装整个 WebExceptionHandler - WebFilter - WebHandler 处理链。这提供了在整条链之前访问请求和响应的能力，以及观察整条链结果的能力。
